title.zh: 将位于奎松市的Epifanio De Los Santos大道与奎松大道延长段交汇处的环形广场命名为Isauro Gabaldon环形广场的法案
title.en: An Act Naming the Rotonda on Quezon Boulevard Extension and Epifanio De Los Santos Avenue in Quezon City, Isauro Gabaldon Rotonda
title.orig: An Act Naming the Rotonda on Quezon Boulevard Extension and Epifanio De Los Santos Avenue in Quezon City, Isauro Gabaldon Rotonda

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1969/ra_5630_1969.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The rotonda on Quezon Boulevard Extension and Epifanio de los Santos Avenue in Quezon City shall hereafter be known and referred to as Isauro Gabaldon Rotonda.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 21, 1969.
